title: ruizia ferruginea
intro: Ruizia ferruginea, commonly known as the Ironwood or Indian copper plant, is a tropical plant native to India and Southeast Asia, characterized by its reddish-brown bark and copper-colored leaves. The plant has been used in traditional medicine to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Ruizia ferruginea include analgesic, anti-arthritic, and antipyretic effects, attributed to its bioactive constituents, which include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, among others. These bioactive compounds are responsible for the plant's medicinal properties and have been studied for their potential in developing new treatments for various diseases.
